evidence.title: Espoo datacenter project updates
evidence.excerpt: Microsoft's May 2026 Espoo update says work at the construction site is progressing and construction of the second building is beginning.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of 204389 content-decoded HTML response bytes retrieved after redirects
metadata.retrieval_method: curl --fail --location --compressed with retries disabled and the DataCenterAtlas research user agent
metadata.status_as_of_normalization: 2026-05-01 is the conservative month-start representation of the source's May 2026 update label, not an asserted observation day.
metadata.status_scope: The source explicitly says work at the Espoo data-center construction site is progressing and construction of the second building is beginning. The lifecycle claim applies only to the second-building project.
metadata.address_scope: The same official project page names the development as the Hepokorpi data-center project. The record does not choose between the page's separate Hepokuja 1 and Hepokuja 2 event locations as a building address.
metadata.coordinate_basis: Rounded analyst placement within the named Espoo locality because the curated schema requires a point; it is not a source coordinate, address geocode, parcel, footprint, building centroid, or unique-site claim.
metadata.phase_guardrail: This project is named from the page's literal second-building wording. It is not asserted to be identical to Microsoft's separately described portfolio-wide second phase.
metadata.metric_guardrail: No critical IT load, gross facility power, grid draw, generation, annual energy, PUE, workload, operating model, or completion claim is imported.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Satellite imagery and computer vision play no role in identity or lifecycle status.
